description_en: Call AddBulkPhoneNumbers to add phone numbers in bulk
kebab_example: aliyun ccc add-bulk-phone-numbers --instance-id d278629c-c687-4aa3-b044-4fe9b0120000 --usage Bidirection --contact-flow-id 8Cvg_0mcsm6K --phone-number example-string --skill-group-id example-string --api-version 2017-07-05 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddBulkPhoneNumbers

parameters.help_en: The ID of the call center instance to which phone numbers are to be added
parameters.help_zh: 待添加电话号码的呼叫中心实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The intended usage of the phone number. Valid values: Inbound (inbound calls), Outbound (outbound calls), Bidirection (both inbound and outbound calls).

If the phone numbers include a 400 number, this value can only be set to Inbound
parameters.help_zh:
该电话号码的用途。取值：Inbound（呼入），Outboung（呼出），Bidirection（同时用于呼入和呼出）。

如果传入的号码包含400号码，该值只能传入Inbound
parameters.name: usage

parameters.help_en: The ID of the contact flow to bind with the phone number
parameters.help_zh: 和电话号码绑定的联系流ID
parameters.name: contact_flow_id

parameters.help_en:
The phone numbers to be added.

The parameter name PhoneNumber.1 indicates adding only one phone number. To add multiple phone numbers, use PhoneNumber.1, PhoneNumber.2, and so on
parameters.help_zh:
待添加电话号码。

参数名称为PhoneNumber.1表示只获取1个技能组信息，如果要获取多个技能组信息，则需要有PhoneNumber.1以及PhoneNumber.2，以此类推
parameters.name: phone_number

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the skill group to bind with the phone number.

The parameter name SkillGroupId.1 indicates only one skill group. To specify multiple skill groups, use SkillGroupId.1, SkillGroupId.2, and so on
parameters.help_zh:
和电话号码绑定的技能组ID。

参数名称为SkillGroupId.1表示只获取1个技能组信息。如果要获取多个技能组信息，则需要有SkillGroupId.1以及SkillGroupId.2，以此类推
parameters.name: skill_group_id
